en: Central University of Finance and Economics
intro: 围绕金融、会计与国际商务开展三年国内学习，为后续海外本科衔接打好语言和专业基础。
introen: Three years of language and specialist study in finance, accounting and international business prepare students for overseas degree progression.
note: 国内阶段为非学历留学培训，不颁发中央财经大学本科毕业证或学位证。海外衔接以语言、学术成绩及接收院校要求为准。
noteen: The domestic stage is non-degree study-abroad training and does not award a CUFE undergraduate degree. Overseas admission depends on language, academic and receiving-university requirements.

en: Shanghai University of Finance and Economics
intro: 以商科为核心，结合会计、理财与商务信息技术。完成国内三年课程后，符合条件者可申请海外本科阶段学习。
introen: A business-focused pathway covering accounting, financial services and business IT, followed by overseas degree study for eligible students.
note: 2026 官方简章的国内学费为 82,800 元/年；与原参考表的 82,000 元不同。本页专业按 2026 简章更新。
noteen: The 2026 brochure lists domestic tuition of RMB 82,800 per year, replacing the RMB 82,000 in the supplied reference. Subjects follow the 2026 brochure.

city: 北京 · 唐山 / 威海
intro: 将商务课程与软件开发、供应链方向结合。按 2026 简章，第一年在唐山或威海学习，第二、三年在北京学习。
introen: Business, software development and supply-chain options. The 2026 route places Year 1 in Tangshan or Weihai and Years 2–3 in Beijing.
note: 海外院校示例来自 2026 简章对接院校名单。不同专业的可选院校、学分衔接和入学要求可能不同。
noteen: The overseas example appears in the 2026 progression list. University options, credit transfer and entry requirements vary by subject.

intro: 依托外语院校的语言学习环境，将英语训练与国际贸易、会计、人力资源和管理课程结合。
introen: A language-rich university setting combines English preparation with trade, accounting, human resources and business studies.
note: 学费与专业依据留服中心官网所载 2024 简章。萨里大学见公开项目资料，尚需向校方确认当年具体衔接安排；并非固定双学位组合。
noteen: Fees and subjects follow the 2024 brochure hosted by CSCSE. Surrey appears in public programme materials; its current progression arrangements require confirmation with BISU. This is not a fixed dual-degree pairing.
foreignlabel: 公开资料院校示例 · 待校方复核
sources: 留服中心所载 2024 简章
海外院校参考资料（非校方域名）

intro: 在旅顺校区学习，兼顾英语沟通与商科实践，提供理财、会计、国际贸易和酒店管理四个方向。
introen: Based on the Lüshun campus, the pathway combines English communication with practical study in finance, accounting, trade and hospitality.
note: 学费与专业依据 2025 官方简章。萨里大学参与学校 2026 年 SQA-AD 合作交流活动；具体可衔接专业和录取条件需进一步确认。
noteen: Fees and subjects follow the 2025 brochure. Surrey participated in the university’s 2026 SQA-AD exchange event; eligible degrees and entry conditions require confirmation.
foreignlabel: 项目合作交流院校示例

intro: 先完成英语与基础课程，再学习两年专业课程。商科与酒店管理方向为后续海外学习提供不同选择。
introen: English and foundation study is followed by two years of specialist courses, with business and hospitality routes for further study abroad.
note: 海外院校示例来自 2026 官方简章。国内课程、语言成绩及申请材料达到接收院校要求后，方可申请衔接。
noteen: The overseas example is listed in the 2026 official brochure. Progression requires suitable course results, language scores and application materials.

en: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
intro: 提供软件开发与商科两类学习方向。国内阶段安排一年语言基础与两年专业学习，再按成绩申请海外衔接。
introen: Software development and business routes combine a language-foundation year with two years of specialist study before overseas applications.
note: 专业、费用及海外本科院校示例依据 2025 官方简章。具体教学地点、年度招生方向和境外课程安排以当年通知为准。
noteen: Subjects, fees and the overseas undergraduate example follow the 2025 brochure. Teaching locations, intake options and overseas study plans follow annual notices.

intro: 围绕国际商务与国际会计展开学习，结合英语能力培养与专业课程，为海外本科阶段做好准备。
introen: International business and accounting studies combine English development with specialist coursework for overseas undergraduate progression.
majors: 国际商务（原参考表：商务管理）
国际会计（原参考表：商务会计）
note: 2024 官方简章使用“国际商务、国际会计”名称，学费为 66,800 元/年。朴茨茅斯大学列于简章的部分海外本科对接院校中。
noteen: The 2024 brochure uses International Business and International Accounting, with tuition of RMB 66,800 per year. Portsmouth is listed among its overseas undergraduate options.
